viewing_check: Check the base: signed W. Moorcroft (blue painted) plus Potter to H.M. the Queen mark (Walter era 1949-86), impressed shape number, and no Queen Mary/Elizabeth era mismatch. Check rim and base for chips, hairlines, restoration (UV torch), glaze crazing and colour strength of the cobalt. Photograph the base and the pattern close up.
